name: Akihabara Momoko
source:
She became a captain at a young age, and found herself a single virgin when she realized she was too busy. Her personality always has her take responsibility for her actions. She is excellent as a commander, and acts as a reliable captain, but her work and personal life are clearly separate. When it comes to her private life, she suddenly becomes a sloppy woman.

She says, "I'm working for my paycheck!" Most of her classmates already have families. She'll spend about five minutes worrying about it, then drink some alcohol to forget about it.
